steps.text: HALL-FX BUG-13 on a running clock: on day 8 (the shift runs 13:00 to 21:00) the shift clock (no forced hour) is moved to 19:25 (HallFxRig's hallClock) and runs at its own pace (1 game minute a second) through the dusk (19:00 to 20:30, D55: sunsetHour 19.75, twilightHours 1.5), so the city's lit share rises in every sequence (the frames.tsv columns hallHour and cityLit record it) and windows fade in during the recording (HallCity.FadeSeconds 0.4 s at the clock's pace). 19:25 is 25 minutes into the dusk, the offset the old 16:10 had in the old dusk (15:45 to 17:15): the lit share (cityWindowsFrom 0.15 of a smoothstep evening) stays 0 until 19:22, and day 1 closes at 17:00 (ShiftClock.Spend clamps at closing), so the recording moved to day 8. The clock is moved 4 s after the traveller arrives, once the speech bubble has typed its greeting (it re-centres its text with each letter, FEEDBACK's), and dusk_city_a1 starts 1 s after the switch back to 1920 x 1080 (its first frames re-laid the view out). Four 10 s sequences, all before closing time: office at A1 (about 19:25-19:35), office at A2, city at A2, city at A1 (about 20:02-20:12). Pass: seqtools flicker on every sequence (each window crosses its fade once: at most 2 toggles; the 8 cars tracked), cityLit rising in each (dusk_check in docs/pending/HALL-FX.md RESULT step 5). LIGHT's dust is hidden for the run ('Hall FX: dust', toggled back at the end): its shimmer is LIGHT's to measure (BUG-13 split, #11).
